findings.description: Criterion 1's current text requires every layer a target host was measured to read to be covered by install_audit and by the gate preflight. install_audit compares only source against .claude/{commands,agents,schemas,skills}. It never names .agents/. Codex was measured to answer from project .agents/skills. The preflight runs only --layers source,global (USERPROFILE/.claude), so that copy is never inspected before a run. The required per-host discovery table (each row marked adapter defect or host behaviour with the deciding measurement) is absent from the subject tree.
findings.evidence: Opened C:/Users/mharvey2/.herdr/worktrees/advanced-planning/loop-008-gate/platforms/python/install_audit.py:183-188 SURFACES = commands/agents/schemas/skills mapping onto installed_base/<name>, and :474-497 resolving project as repo_root/.claude and global as resolve_global_home()/.claude. ripgrep of that file for .agents returned zero hits. run-gate.md:40 is `install_audit --layers source,global`; test_gate_preflight_layers.py:46 asserts equality to that pair and rejects `all`. Subject grep of core/, docs/, and platforms/ for F20|F21|host behaviour|adapter defect|four-host discovery table returned no constraint table; the four-host digest and per-host verdicts exist only as controller evidence (2026-09-03-loop-007-6-host-discovery-measured.md): codex -> project .agents/skills, opencode/claude -> global ~/.claude/skills, cursor -> neither.

failure_notes: Criterion 1 is still open. loop-007-8 added the skills surface and switched the preflight to source,global; that covers the global ~/.claude/skills copy opencode and claude were measured to serve, and it does not cover the project .agents/skills copy Codex was measured to serve. Name those loops in the retry record; do not revert their commits.

Do not close criterion 1 from the 2026-09-03 rewrite note's gloss (preflight must include global) while the current criterion text still requires every measured layer. A preflight that only audits ~/.claude/ cannot report drift in .agents/skills.

Give install_audit a first-class audited surface for .agents/skills (or an equivalent layer pair whose installed_base is not .claude/). Prove it with a planted drift in an .agents skill that the audit reports stale, and a matching copy it reports current. A SURFACES table entry that still resolves under .claude/ is the same blind spot.

Make the gate preflight actually invoke every layer pair a measured host reads. Do not use --layers all until project resolution targets the consumer project rather than find_repo_root(__file__)/.claude (install_audit.py:474-478; the 27-MISSING measurement).

Maintain the four-host discovery table in the subject checkout as a recorded constraint, not only as controller evidence. Each row must be marked adapter defect or host behaviour and cite the measurement that decided it (codex: own .agents copy; opencode: global ~/.claude wins on name collision, host behaviour; claude: same precedence, host behaviour; cursor: no project skill loader under -p --mode ask, host constraint).
Do not treat a WARN-only preflight that never looks at .agents as having 'reported a drifted copy before a run' for Codex.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Every layer a target host is measured to read is covered by the shipped install audit, and the gate preflight runs it over those layers, so a drifted copy is reported before a run rather than discovered after one. The per-host discovery table is maintained as recorded constraint, each entry marked adapter defect or host behaviour with the measurement that decided it.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: install_audit.py has no .agents reference; SURFACES and both layer resolvers are .claude-only. Gate preflight is --layers source,global only (run-gate.md:40; test_gate_preflight_layers.py:46). Codex's measured read layer is therefore unaudited. No per-host discovery table with adapter-defect/host-behaviour marks exists under the subject core/, docs/, or platforms/. Skills-under-.claude and the global preflight are present (loop-007-8) and are not sufficient for the current wording.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: A fixture programme can create one phase, one loop, and one external task on every target host.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: next-loop.md:212-226 calls prepare_external_task_envelope and prints a failure if the write does not succeed; test_evidence_gate.py::test_next_loop_step_4_writes_envelope guards the call form (name followed by '(' on a non-import line). state_manager.prepare_external_task_envelope writes a schema-valid envelope whose base_sha is git-derived (test_state_manager.py). setup/{codex,opencode,cursor}/install.sh copy the shared router plus core/skills into .agents/skills. pytest of the envelope/gate/scope modules: 186 passed. The claude-code text that previously said 'nothing in this adapter writes one' is gone from the shipped command.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Only the control checkout updates programme state; a worker attempting a planning-state edit fails collection — ACC-08.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: validate_advancement requires --baseline on the CLI and derives changed_paths via _derive_changed_paths_from_git; evidence.git.changed_paths is not consulted (evidence_gate.py:241, 347-370, 709-712). test_worker_omission_of_forbidden_file_caught asserts a worker-omitted .advanced-plans/state/forbidden.json is still blocked from git. default_worker_scope forbids history.jsonl, loop-ready.json, archive, gate-verdicts, evidence, PLANNING.md, and .claude/settings.json. Envelope forbidden_paths include .advanced-plans/state/. One named carve-out remains for .advanced-plans/state/loop-complete.json on the unmigrated claude-code protocol, pinned as a file-not-directory hole by test_default_worker_scope.py. 186 relevant tests passed.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Collected evidence advances a loop only after both schema validation and gate validation pass.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: Shared SKILL.md:160 and :216-222 invoke evidence_gate (loop-complete and collected-evidence) with --baseline before advancement; resume refuses to finalize without that gate. Schema is always required; policy_self_review reads the evidence policy block and blocks independent_review_passed=false; path scope is git-derived. Absent verdicts record gate_result.result=not_requested rather than fabricating pass (evidence_gate.py:305-309, 568-570); CLI requires --verdict or --no-verdicts-requested. Case A/B/C tests in test_evidence_gate.py passed in the 186-test run.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: The CI path audit fails on any host-specific path in core/.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: Ran `python -m platforms.python.path_audit` on the subject tree: exit 0, PASSED WITH 26 SUPPRESSED, scanning core/agents, core/schemas, core/skills, core/state among the roots. VIOLATION_PATTERNS includes host-directory (.agents|.claude|.codex|.cursor|.gemini|.opencode)/ and host-adapter-path platforms/(claude-code|codex|cowork|cursor|opencode)/. CI job Path Convention Audit runs the same module (.github/workflows/ci.yml:150-152). test_path_audit.py::TestHostAdapterPathPattern plants platforms/claude-code/ under core/skills and proves removing the pattern lets it pass; that module was in the 186 passed.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: No adapter duplicates a core skill's content; adapters install and register, they do not fork.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: core/skills holds the nine planning skills. platforms/{codex,opencode,cursor} contain only README.md; the only adapter SKILL.md files are platforms/shared/agent-skills/advanced-planning (shared router) and platforms/cowork/SKILL.md (Cowork router, not a core skill name). setup/{codex,opencode,cursor}/install.sh copy from $REPO_ROOT/core/skills/$_skill; setup/claude-code/install.sh copies or symlinks core/skills. No forked phase-plan-creator (or sibling) bodies live under platforms/.
